name: Hypercubes Are Strictly Complete-Theta
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every hypercube has complete Theta-graph, and the containment is strict.
proof: For median graphs the crossing graph equals the Theta-graph exactly for hypercubes, so a hypercube has complete Theta-graph. The cycle $C_6$ also has complete Theta-graph but is not a hypercube.
